title: SpaceFAQ draws a starter kit's questions until the Space has its own
detail: SpaceFAQ read only the Space's saved FAQs and ignored the `items` the starter kits write (profile kits for Network and Wildheart, the Questions page, every Home FAQ), so a kit's FAQ drew nothing until the owner typed their own. It now declares a `starter questions` array: the Space's own questions win, the kit's draw until there are some, and the kit's sample words carry no FAQPage structured data.

verify.evidence: spaces.tsx declares the SpaceFAQ items field and the starter fallback.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("components/page-editor/blocks/spaces.tsx","utf8");if(!t.includes("starter-${i}")||!t.includes("Starter questions")){console.error("SpaceFAQ lost its starter questions");process.exit(1)}'
